## How was it tested?

- [ ] `node --check` passes for changed first-party JavaScript.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and understandable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private URLs, or personal financial data are included.
- [ ] External market-data assumptions are documented if changed.
- [ ] Accessibility and graceful failure were considered.
- [ ] Documentation / `CHANGELOG.md` updated when appropriate.
- [ ] CI is green before merge.
